cases.input: Build a Class D conformity plan from confirmed IVDR classification, completed performance evidence, current MDCG/EU sources and known NB/EURL dependencies.
requiredBehaviors: start from an explicit Class D classification state and reuse upstream performance evidence
map current NB EURL common-specification and batch-testing dependencies with verified external-state boundaries
forbiddenBehaviors: re-run the full IVDR classification or performance evaluation inside the conformity plan
claim an NB EURL or authority result without verified external evidence

cases.input: The device is Class D, but it is unclear whether a currently designated EURL covers this specific analyte/device scope and whether batch testing applies as assumed by an old project plan.
requiredBehaviors: verify current EURL designation scope and applicable external requirements before treating them as mandatory project gates
keep uncertain or non-applicable dependencies explicit with rationale instead of inheriting old assumptions
forbiddenBehaviors: assume every Class D device has identical EURL scope and batch-testing implementation
reuse stale EURL or common-specification assumptions without current-source verification

cases.input: An internal batch is ready but a required external test or review is still pending; management asks to mark the external gate complete and remember the current batch result globally.
requiredBehaviors: keep the required external batch or review gate blocking until verified completion evidence exists
keep concrete batch identifiers external results and current NB/EURL state out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: convert internal release readiness into a completed external conformity gate
persist batch-specific or external-review state as timeless memory
